name: RX 7900 XTX (GPU0) llama.cpp ROCm 7.1.1: Llama-2-7B Q4_0 FA-off tg128
methodology: llama-bench, build 34ce48d97 (7356), ROCm backend on ROCm 7.1.1, Arch Linux 6.12.61-1-lts. The published table gives ngl 99, fa 0, test tg128, on device 0 of a 2x RX 7900 XTX gfx1100 box, 24 GB. Reported 118.82 +/- 0.05. Per-request batch-1 decode, not aggregate. Device 1 scored 130.67 +/- 0.24 on the identical test.
notes: Well below the maintainer scoreboard row for this card: discussion #15021 recorded 167.11 tok/s on the same model, quant, and tg128 test with build 2f0c2db (llamacpp-rocm-7900xtx-llama27b-q40-nofa-tg128). Kept as a second measurement rather than a correction, because the build, the ROCm version, and the clocks all differ, and this repo's own two cards already disagree by about 10 percent.
